rationale:
Positives: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and ZIP when the email lookup failed. They inspected order details via tools, correctly identified the most expensive item, asked for explicit confirmation before attempting any order change and again before canceling, and then executed the cancellation using the appropriate tool. They did not perform any writes without prior confirmation and acted only on the authenticated user’s order.

However, there are policy violations regarding unsupported information: the agent stated a precise total refund amount ($1,166.98) and a refund timeframe (5–7 business days) without tool evidence. The order-total field was not shown in the tool outputs, and item details were truncated, so the exact total could not be verified. The refund timeframe was also presented as fact absent any tool confirmation. The policy requires not inventing facts and providing correct final information. This unsupported specificity makes the overall outcome fail the pass bar.
